name: @roryscot/metamap
description: Language-neutral semantic linker, authority graph, and static projection compiler

scripts.example:bindings: npm run build && node examples/routing/bindings/build.mjs && tsc --noEmit --target ES2022 --module NodeNext --moduleResolution NodeNext examples/routing/bindings/consumer/consumer.ts
scripts.validate:example: npm run build && node dist/cli.js validate examples/example-authority-graph.json
scripts.example:generate: npm run build && node dist/cli.js generate examples/workspace/metamap.config.json --no-cache
scripts.example:check: npm run build && node dist/cli.js check examples/workspace/metamap.config.json --no-cache
scripts.example:compile: npm run build && node dist/cli.js compile examples/example-authority-graph.json examples/example-viability-policy.json examples/example-generation.json --context examples/example-context.json --as-of 2026-09-02T00:00:00.000Z && prettier --write examples/example-generation.json
scripts.example:research: npm run build && node dist/cli.js generate examples/research/metamap.config.json --no-cache && node dist/cli.js compile examples/research/generated/graph.json examples/research/viability-policy.json examples/research/generated/generation.json --relation-pack relation-packs/research.json --as-of 2026-09-02T00:00:00.000Z && prettier --write examples/research/generated
scripts.example:routing: npm run build && node dist/cli.js compile examples/routing/graph.json examples/routing/viability-policy.json examples/routing/generated/generation.json --relation-pack relation-packs/routing.json --as-of 2026-09-02T00:00:00.000Z && node dist/cli.js link examples/routing/graph.json examples/routing/generated/generation.json examples/routing/projection.json examples/routing/generated/command-router.json --relation-pack relation-packs/routing.json && node dist/cli.js link examples/routing/graph.json examples/routing/generated/generation.json examples/routing/projection.json examples/routing/generated/command-router.ts --format typescript --export commandRoutes --relation-pack relation-packs/routing.json && prettier --write examples/routing/generated && tsc --noEmit --target ES2022 --module NodeNext --moduleResolution NodeNext examples/routing/generated/command-router.ts
scripts.example:path-tree: npm run build && node dist/cli.js compile examples/path-tree/graph.json examples/path-tree/viability-policy.json examples/path-tree/generated/generation.json --relation-pack relation-packs/routing.json --as-of 2026-09-15T00:00:00.000Z && node dist/cli.js link examples/path-tree/graph.json examples/path-tree/generated/generation.json examples/path-tree/projection.json examples/path-tree/generated/routes.json --format path-tree --relation-pack relation-packs/routing.json && node dist/cli.js link examples/path-tree/graph.json examples/path-tree/generated/generation.json examples/path-tree/projection.json examples/path-tree/generated/routes.ts --format path-tree-typescript --export routes --relation-pack relation-packs/routing.json && prettier --write examples/path-tree/generated && tsc --noEmit --target ES2022 --module NodeNext --moduleResolution NodeNext examples/path-tree/generated/routes.ts
scripts.example:topology: npm run build && node dist/cli.js compile examples/application-topology/graph.json examples/application-topology/viability-policy.json examples/application-topology/generated/generation.json --relation-pack relation-packs/routing.json --relation-pack relation-packs/application-topology.json --as-of 2026-09-08T00:00:00.000Z && node dist/cli.js link examples/application-topology/graph.json examples/application-topology/generated/generation.json examples/application-topology/projection.json examples/application-topology/generated/application-topology.json --relation-pack relation-packs/routing.json --relation-pack relation-packs/application-topology.json && node dist/cli.js link examples/application-topology/graph.json examples/application-topology/generated/generation.json examples/application-topology/projection.json examples/application-topology/generated/application-topology.ts --format typescript --export applicationTopology --relation-pack relation-packs/routing.json --relation-pack relation-packs/application-topology.json && prettier --write examples/application-topology/generated && tsc --noEmit --target ES2022 --module NodeNext --moduleResolution NodeNext examples/application-topology/generated/application-topology.ts
scripts.example:relations: npm run build && node examples/relations/build.mjs && prettier --write examples/relations/generated && tsc --noEmit --target ES2022 --module NodeNext --moduleResolution NodeNext examples/relations/generated/dependency-bindings.ts examples/relations/generated/dependency-tree.ts
scripts.example:uncertainty: npm run build && node examples/uncertainty/build.mjs && prettier --write examples/uncertainty/generated && tsc --noEmit --target ES2022 --module NodeNext --moduleResolution NodeNext examples/uncertainty/generated/network-bindings.ts examples/uncertainty/generated/network-tree.ts
scripts.example:provenance: npm run build && node examples/provenance/build.mjs && prettier --write examples/provenance/generated && tsc --noEmit --target ES2022 --module NodeNext --moduleResolution NodeNext examples/provenance/generated/network-bindings.ts examples/provenance/generated/network-tree.ts
